cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Be There for Me
cards.instruction: Get someone to show up, help, or stay involved as proof that the connection still matters.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Dad, come to my sculpture opening. I've spent years teaching you to stand beside my work without asking what it is. I want you there.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I still don't know anything about sculpture.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You've mastered 'that's big.' We'll build on that. Just stand beside me for one photograph.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your mother arrives at seven. We haven't spoken since the divorce.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Come at six and help me unpack the biggest one. I'll teach you which end to hold. Then we can take our picture before you're worried about where to stand.
